about: I’ve been building software professionally since 2016, starting with freelance PHP and JavaScript work in fintech. Since then I’ve worked across consulting and in-house teams — a path that grew out of a system administration background and a foundation in computer science and entrepreneurship.

What I enjoy most is taking software that feels complicated and making it feel simple — designing reliable, intuitive systems that get out of people’s way. Today I’m on the product team at GoMeddo in the Netherlands, building tools that help businesses manage complex scheduling workflows.
Outside of work, I play music and run to clear my head, travel when I can, and explore Utrecht by bike with my wife, Rachel.
